Decision to make

You support a software delivery team. Design merge and deployment gates with rollback evidence.

Core concept

Fail visibly when required checks fail. Separate code authoring, review and deployment authorization. Do not let an automated reviewer approve its own unverified output.

Practice contract

Map missing confidence to needs_data, below 0.8 to human_review, otherwise awaiting_approval. Never mark an action executed.

Evidence and boundary

Show normal, missing and uncertain cases. No real data or external actions.

Review and reflect

Not without independent gates and authorization
